'''Tavion Alde''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a Pistoleer [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of [[House Alde]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
